I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that I can't give him one settled renewal date yet, because the records disagree:

- The signed 2025-26 renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025) says the renewal date is 30 November 2026, when the current term ends. The Brackenwater account profile, last updated 30 Sep, says the same.
- On 14 Oct, Ilse posted in #north-team that the next renewal is 25 November. I found no amendment or other record that explains the change.
- A CRM note from February says 31 December 2026, which matches neither.

I suggested he check with Ilse whether 25 November is a newly agreed date or a mistake before he updates the account sheet.

I only shared dates, which count as operational facts, and no money terms. I didn't change anything.
